answer: Farming becomes an anchor bet on surviving 89 epochs of grading, and every sparrow settlement recomputes the gale schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 89 epochs rather than arriving at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
